About

Giampiero Bittarelli

Fifteen years of coaching, LTA Level 3, and a BSc (Hons) in Sports Psychology & Coaching Science — all pointed at one belief: no two players learn the same way.

That belief shapes everything. Private sessions start from how you take information in, not from a syllabus. Clinics are built so beginners and intermediates get genuinely different work, rather than the same drill at two speeds.

I run my own clinics and tennis holidays. The knowledge behind them comes from two places: teaching myself the game as a self-taught player, and working directly alongside former professionals and multiple Grand Slam winners, including Pat Cash.

Everything else goes out free. The breakdowns, the drills, the shot analysis on Instagram: that is how the following past 100,000 across platforms was built, and it stays free.

  • Player-centred
  • Strategy & the mental game
  • Grand Slam experience
  • Tennis holidays
